description: Semantic roles built ONLY from foundation colors with >=5 real utility references. `dawn` (2), `desert` (2), `midnight` (2) and `bone` (0) are deliberately NOT promoted: they are decorative one-offs or unused, and giving them a semantic role would invite a generator to use them systemically where the real site never does.

notPromoted.dawn: 2 uses, both the /platform rail gradient. Decorative one-off.
notPromoted.desert: 2 uses, both blur-ellipse decorations. Decorative one-off.
notPromoted.midnight: 2 uses (Button dark bg, cookie-notice panel). Exposed as a COMPONENT token instead — see tokens/20-component/component.json.

text.root.note: the html-element default color; most sections override it

text.secondary.onLight.note: the site has no separate muted colour — secondary text is primary at opacity 80%

border.hairline.onLight.note: the square-bracket primitive's currentColor on light surfaces

border.hairline.onDark.note: the square-bracket primitive's currentColor on dark surfaces
